title: Marvel Franchise Overview
body:
Marvel's characters originated in comic books published by Marvel Comics and its predecessors, beginning in the late 1930s, and the Marvel Cinematic Universe films from 2008 onward brought the same characters to cinema in a shared continuity documented in public release records.

This public edition records only verifiable facts — titles, credited creators, publication and release years and formats — in original wording, with no copied comic panels, dialogue or script text.

The companion Signature edition is separate, labeled unofficial fiction with original heroes and cities, and it claims no affiliation with or endorsement by Marvel or Disney.

How to use this record: start with the overview, then read the work-by-work records in publication order. Every date and credit below is a public fact; no copyrighted text is reproduced anywhere in this database.

print("Works recorded: 10")

title: Marvel Reading and Viewing Order Guide
body:
Recommended public order for the works in this database is publication and release order, beginning with Amazing Fantasy #15 (first Spider-Man comic) (1962) and ending with Avengers: Endgame (2019). That order follows how the franchise actually reached the public, and it avoids assuming any later reordering.

The full order is: Amazing Fantasy #15 (first Spider-Man comic) (1962); The Avengers #1 (1963); X-Men (film) (2000); Iron Man (2008); The Avengers (2012); Captain America: The Winter Soldier (2014); Guardians of the Galaxy (2014); Thor: Ragnarok (2017); Black Panther (2018); Avengers: Endgame (2019). Each title in that list has its own record in this database with its credited creators and format.

This guide contains facts only. It does not reproduce story text, and it does not claim that any Signature continuation belongs in the official order.

print("Works in public order: " + str(len(order)))

print("Last: " + order[-1])
